title: Promise Cinderella
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hayame, a 27-year-old housewife, is suddenly divorced and robbed, and ends up homeless. A rich, mean-spirited high-school boy, Issei, draws her into a strange challenge, and she ends up living and working at his family's ryokan while a romance with an age gap develops (Comikey blurb via AniList; MU; L'Eclaireur Fnac article).
life_message: Pain can be a turning point: a person thrown down can rebuild a life with grit and self-respect.

content.note: Fnac lists physical violence and harassment as themes; MU lists Attempted Murder, Kidnapping, Domestic Abuse, Violence.
Stalker, psychopath and yandere elements (MU; AniList spoiler tag).

Romance between a 27-year-old divorced woman and a high-school student (MU Student-Adult Relationship, Age Gap; AniList Age Gap; Fnac 'a complex relationship between a mature woman and a high school student'). Explicitness not reported (to verify). Cheating husband (MU).
Emotional collapse after divorce and poverty (Fnac); Bullying (AniList, MU), Mental Illness (MU).
Betting and revenge schemes (MU Betting/s, Revenge); Issei's cruel 'game' (Comikey blurb, to verify).

dominant: Rebuilding a woman's life after divorce; age-gap romance; wealth and cruelty

frames.aligns: Hayame's resilience and dignity after betrayal.
frames.concerns: Romance between an adult and a minor; divorce normalized.

delivery.evidence: Fnac describes a 'disenchanted' Cinderella shown through harsh situations, not lessons (to verify).
